items.title: This repo is missing .github/workflows/auto-enable-merge.yml, so its release PR has been parked since 2026-07-24 and NO release-please PR has ever merged here
Credential re-exec loop guard is inert: the sentinel is env-borne and every measured wrapper drops it
Reconcile the ratified public-surface inventory with the 70 exported-but-undocumented names
Adopt the public-API Result railway so the pure_trees un-gating can re-land
CI detect-py-changes gate skips all real checks for a pyproject-only PR — config changes merge with vacuous-green CI
(BUG) The stale-worktree detector is silenced by ANY untracked file, so machine-generated dirt hides exactly the worktrees that accumulate
tests/heading-coverage.json carries 29 unowned TODO entries; CI never arms the TODO-ownership release tier, but the doc-only pre-commit path does, so any local registry edit is refused
homelab-loop-hardening-runtime: ratify the shared attention surface (baseline-first), then the minimal generic extension
contracts.md states CLOSED/UNKNOWN do not block, which PR #296 made false for sibling_work_item — needs a propose-change/revise pass; no gate catches it
branch_exists_on_remote 404 detection uses stderr substring, not exit code / structured field
New public symbols (github_auth / work_items) lack scenarios.md entries
CI must invoke `just check` aggregate, not the per-target matrix
Port the worktree-create guidance into AGENTS.md: raw `git worktree add` yields a worktree that cannot commit or push
github_budget_client_support.mapping_option: an unchecked cast returns a wrongly-typed option value, so the Mapping[str, str] annotation is asserted rather than true
Retrofit: route this repo's own direct GitHub calls through the budgeted client
head_is_merged uses branch-head ancestry, which is always false under rebase-merge — hygiene under-reports reapable worktrees
doctor-static source scan should honor gitignore (or exclude known tool-scratch dirs like mutants/)
Release commits bump pyproject.toml but not uv.lock, so every fresh checkout gets a spurious lockfile diff (overseer does this correctly 25 of 25)
